evidence.reason: The final catch-all handles any unexpected rejection from effects such as writeReport() (and readQueue()) after the explicit BackfillRouteError/BackfillInventoryError/BackfillReportError branches have already selected refused()/exit 3. Returning refused(message) here maps a generic storage or unexpected failure to the same needs-human exit code as an explicit refusal. That conflates an unintended thrown error with an explicit refusal; the generic failure path should return a failed artifact with exitCode 1. The existing explicit domain-error branches retain exit 3, so this is a narrow correctness fix, not an owner-level behavior change.
